pool-surround-tiling-adelaide.html/html[.source: We provide pool surround tiling for the walking surfaces and terraces around a pool. The layout and preparation account for coping edges, adjoining paving, drainage, movement junctions and the connection to the existing pool edge.
pool-surround-tiling-adelaide.html/html[.target: 为泳池周边步行面和露台铺砖。排布准备兼顾池沿、相邻铺装、排水、伸缩交接及现有池边连接。

pool-surround-tiling-adelaide.html/html[.source: Poolside materials need to suit their location and use. We consider the selected tile and its product information with the expected wet conditions, cleaning and exposed edges before agreeing the finish.
pool-surround-tiling-adelaide.html/html[.target: 池边材料需适合位置用途。确认饰面前，结合所选砖及产品资料，评估潮湿条件、清洁和外露边缘。

pool-surround-tiling-adelaide.html/html[.source: This service covers pool surrounds, not tiling or waterproofing inside the pool. Pool-interior or water-retaining work needs a separate suitability assessment and confirmed scope. A pool surround photograph is not evidence of a pool-interior membrane installation.
pool-surround-tiling-adelaide.html/html[.target: 本服务涵盖泳池周边，不含泳池内部贴砖或防水。池内或蓄水施工需独立适用性评估及范围确认。周边照片不能证明池内防水膜安装。

pool-surround-tiling-adelaide.html/html[.source: Movement at coping tiles and connections to adjoining paving needs assessment before a replacement finish is agreed. We check the accessible base, edge details and how the selected tile thickness meets existing levels. The scope identifies the removal boundary, protection of the pool and any preparation needed for the terrace. A surround repair does not diagnose water loss from the pool.
pool-surround-tiling-adelaide.html/html[.target: 确认替换饰面前，评估池沿砖位移及与相邻铺装连接。检查可接触基层、边缘及砖厚与现有高度衔接。范围列明拆除边界、泳池保护及露台准备。周边维修不能诊断泳池失水。

pool-surround-tiling-adelaide.html/html[.source: Pool surround slip resistance and drainage

Wet walking surfaces need material suitability considered through the selected product information and intended use. Appearance alone does not establish slip resistance. We plan surface drainage, movement junctions and exposed edges together, with cleaning and care requirements explained at handover. For an enquiry about water-retaining surfaces, confirm the separate pool waterproofing scope before assuming it is included.
pool-surround-tiling-adelaide.html/html[.target: 潮湿步行面需按产品资料和用途评估材料，外观不能证明防滑性。排水、伸缩交接和外露边缘整体规划，交付时解释清洁保养。咨询蓄水表面时，应先确认独立泳池防水范围，不能假定已包含。

pool-surround-tiling-adelaide.html/html[.source: Describe the terrace, coping edges and adjoining paving, including loose tiles or ponding. We assess the walking surface and pool protection needed during work.
pool-surround-tiling-adelaide.html/html[.target: 描述露台、池沿及相邻铺装，包括松砖或积水。我们评估步行表面和施工期间所需泳池保护。

pool-surround-tiling-adelaide.html/html[.source: Tile suitability, drainage, movement junctions and finished levels are included in the agreed surround scope.
pool-surround-tiling-adelaide.html/html[.target: 约定周边施工范围包含瓷砖适用性、排水、伸缩交接及完成面高度。

pool-surround-tiling-adelaide.html/html[.source: Assess the accessible surface, its condition and the intended finish.
pool-surround-tiling-adelaide.html/html[.target: 评估可接触表面、现状及期望饰面。

pool-surround-tiling-adelaide.html/html[.source: Confirm preparation, material responsibility, boundaries and access in a written scope.
pool-surround-tiling-adelaide.html/html[.target: 书面确认准备、材料责任、边界与通行。
